scope: Account for proved solutions and failed visits, freeze named or direct config authority, and preserve the source and delegated companion contexts through exact execution coloring and solution publication (I02/I07/I08).

sourceMapping.packages/limina/src/__tests__/analysis-c: actual Core failure independently of a drained worklist
sourceMapping.packages/limina/src/__tests__/independen: keeps independent work when explicit authority conflicts
inherited owners for the same source

stateVariables.scenario: Named selection, direct configuration intents, exceptional role proof, selected checker outcome, and exact component pins. At most one named checker.
stateVariables.role: Registered candidate, proved solution, source, or failed role probe.
stateVariables.pending,seen: Unobserved and observed direct auto configuration intents. Inherited settings, source membership and dependencies supply no intents.
stateVariables.frozen,family: Authority snapshot vs current family after coloring.
stateVariables.owner,solution: Single source owner, separate checker set for nested or empty solution.
stateVariables.contexts: Prepared source context and any separately purposed TypeScript companion context.
stateVariables.phase: Role discovery, intent collection, freeze, source preparation, execution selection, manifest, component rejection, or unavailable scope.

initialState: A registered discovery candidate and direct configuration intents in unspecified delivery order. No prepared context or published owner.
assumptions: One representative candidate and a fixed sibling for the shared solution. The role oracle supplies the outcome of an exceptional default-config probe. The selected source parser's preparation outcome is trusted. CacheReopen owns qualification when the selected parser can restore a result. Framework companion scenarios require one delegated TypeScript purpose. Multiple inferred framework intents permit the Native baseline; CLI tests own warning reporting. Independent diagnostic collection and execution outcomes after later framework failures are implementation witnesses. Explicit-selection conflicts, coverage impacts of other failed scopes, file membership, parser internals and compiler passes are outside the model.

safety.ConfigAuthority: Named selection wins. A single direct framework intent determines the family. Zero or multiple direct intents freeze Native.
safety.RoleAccounted: A registered candidate leaves the source universe only after a successful solution proof. A failed role remains unavailable.
safety.LockedContexts: Prepare one locked source context. Astro and Svelte companion contexts carry their framework authority and a different purpose. A proved solution has no source context.
safety.FailedScope: A failed role or source preparation yields no successful source context or published owner.
safety.ExactComponent: Same semantic family is not exact execution identity.
safety.SourceOwner: Admitted source has a primary checker.
safety.SolutionConsumers: Solution collects checkers of member sources only.
safety.LegalCases: The legal examples must not be refused.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 6 or 14 scenarios, up to two configuration intents and two qualified context purposes.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Last-wins makes implicit authority depend on order. Inherited intent changes a leaf's authority. A failed role probe drops an unenumerated scope. Generic pending collection duplicates locked collection. Detached companion analysis loses its owning framework. A shared solution can consume multiple exact checkers.
empiricalVerification: Run generated-graph.spec.ts (direct and ambiguous intent, solution discovery, Vue promotion and shared solutions), typecheck.spec.ts (inherited named ownership), analysis-observation.spec.ts (source and companion purposes), independent-core-governance.spec.ts (scoped failure), and analysis-completion.spec.ts (Core outcome and admission boundaries).
